notes: AIG confirms a separate visitor eVisa and no visa-on-arrival facility. Visitor stay is up to three months per stay and no more than three cumulative months in any 12-month period. The 2026 visitor fee is GBP 40 standard or GBP 60 fast track; under-12 fee is GBP 10. The portal aims to determine 90 percent of applications within 21 days and complex cases can take up to six weeks. Bangladesh ordinary-passport eligibility remains unconfirmed: Bangladesh is absent from the published no-issue nationality list, but the live nationality selector result was not captured. Bangladesh is on the current UK visa-national list, and Ascension says a multi-entry UK visa valid for outward and return journeys may be required unless travel is via the Falkland Islands. The official FAQ requires a scanned JPEG face photo, says no fixed dimensions and no standard printed photo unless specifically requested, and notes that biometric fingerprints and a facial photograph may be requested. Keep research-only; no visa record is created and no Bangladesh tourism requirement is published.
photo_summary: Scanned JPEG photo required; any clear-face image is acceptable and need not be passport quality; no fixed dimensions published; no standard printed photo unless specifically requested; fingerprints and a facial image may be requested as biometrics; no Bangladesh VAC confirmed.
checklist_summary: Mandatory in the published visitor FAQ: scanned photo and medical insurance unless exempt; air medical-evacuation cover minimum GBP 500000. Supporting documents may include onward itinerary and place-of-stay information for stays of 48 hours or more; under-18 parental consent and guardian passport; verifiable translations for non-English documents. Bangladesh-specific applicability remains unconfirmed.
